intent.proves: At least one price matrix entry is restricted to a country, shop, language, variant or stock location.

bindings.reason: get_prices_by_product_id reads prices per product; no whole-host price enumeration tool exists, so a host-wide count is not an equivalent observation.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomPrices WHERE ISNULL(PriceCountry, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceShopId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceProductLanguageId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceProductVariantId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceStockLocationID, 0) <> 0
